environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway. All S3 traffic routes through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that uses a condition key restricting PutObject to only the bucket 'default-diagnostics-audit' AND requires the s3:prefix to start with 'diagnostics/'. The endpoint policy also includes a condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4 to prevent cross-account exfiltration. The task role's permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/DiagBoundary) limits s3:PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::default-diagnostics-audit/diagnostics/*. Container runs with a read-only root filesystem and seccomp profile blocking execve syscall family (clone, fork, vfork, execve, execveat) via ECS task definition securityContext.

config.network: private subnet, no NAT, no IGW
